title: Cakkih Seecta Xongolo
intro: Dumaahi Midiyaan baaxol, tellemmo elle sugteeh, caravanitte fidin bacaritteh addat gexak sugteeh, qadli gitak yewqeh yan marih fanat Yallih nabiyyi ugte. Tama Yallih taama abeena inkih tan ummattah imaan gibbatu wayta qibaadah farmo luk ruube. sabri kee angadad gibbatut, ta rooci aydaadul qagaaqagitak maabitina xayyoysaanamal maqar luk soole. Atu tama diggale farmoytih cuumi baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu Yalli doorem qadlii kee diggah radmooma habbalte ummatta miraacissuh abte taamal.
Anu farmo tatruse yi ummatta Yallak iroh num akah qibaaban innah kee kulli caagidil nummat yaabanam.
Anu Baxsaluk Umaadoobi Abinosiya Gaddalite Madqak iroh Yan Gititel Mabitina kee Qadliinole Qilsa kee Aqakkaane Tuxxiqil Kassiise.
Yi ummatta yi maabitina anqasak gacisse, anu inni farmot bisoh axcek ken baaxok yoo diiriye lon.
Anu inni farmol margaqa luk suge ken naqboytiino takkay immay, yi acwa Yalla dubuk kinnim baxxaqisak.
Yi ummatta yi farmo kibbimte wak anu inni Rabbih racmattat cattiimeh an wak yi ummatta finqah tan digaalat yibbixen.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Nabi Shuqayb
Huud farmoyti
Nabi Saalih
Nabiyyi Luut
Nabi Macammad صلى الله عليه وسلم

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: numma cinaay yallih farmo tatruseemih digaalah meysiisa ummatta foocal haanam
Agat kaafir bayseh yan kaxxa weeqa sumaaqisaanama.
Of goloh addat safarta wak wayu hargaanama
diini gibbatu qanxaffe le mirac tibba haam gabbate wak inki rabbih seeco
Agat liggiditteh ammirtime waytiik lakal gibdi qabaar uddur rob essera
trial.answer: numma cinaay yallih farmo tatruseemih digaalah meysiisa ummatta foocal haanam

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: Midiyan baaxo, yi ummatta tellemmoo kee tellemmo elle gexsisse
kaxxa markabih baaxal diini mara weeqi qawwalaylak cate
malcina qunxaaneyti gadaamak dabboh elle gorrisan xaahi qalel tan gabla
Anu bar safarah elle beenim diini magaala ursalem
Shebah addal tan daala kaxxa amoytiini qibaadah asta yabloonuh gulgulusen
location.answer: Midiyan baaxo, yi ummatta tellemmoo kee tellemmo elle gexsisse

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Yi-ummatta gibdih yan digaalet yibbixeenih anu cattiimak suge way, inni dirki Yallal inkih duuduseh sugeemih sabbatah.
Kuufir mari damaaqe fanah gacteeh Yallih naysiise cuduud elle yiggilen innal.
yi qaduwwi assakat le milaagu yubleenik geera imaan oggoleh
Ummatta toobittek lakal ardi mango rob kee leedat barkat geyte.
Anu yi farmo cabam cineemih taagah inni ummattal nadaabiteh suge.
outcome.answer: Yi-ummatta gibdih yan digaalet yibbixe anu cattiimak suge way, anu inni dirki Yallal duuduseh sugeemih sabbatah.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verse: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh? (26:177)
